honesty.why: every (symbol, condition, horizon) cell evaluated is counted and carried, so deflation downstream charges the real width of this search rather than the flattering subset that survived the reporting floor
honesty.report_t_is_not_a_gate: REPORT_T only decides what reaches the naming queue. It sets no bar: the canonical ten gates remain the only arbiter and nothing here competes with them
honesty.unnamed: every row is mechanism_status=UNNAMED. An anomaly is an observation; turning one into a candidate without a named, falsifiable cause is the prose-to-family guessing the compiler refuses
